summary: The driver now halts per R-3: per-run budget checks between iterations (max-iterations 4, cost ceiling 6, convergence 5), stall streak (3, status stalled), failed work session (7, no attempt), repeat-blocked (8, surfacing the first diagnosis) and moved refs (9, nothing committed, log says REFS MOVED <task|plan>). Ported tests 04/05/06/07/11/19/42/44 plus TestRunBudgetPrecedence.
verified: The task's verify command printed 'gate T7 ok'; go test ./internal/... passes.
notes: internal/cli/run.go needed no change (flags and Ending.Code mapping already there). Spend is summed from sessions/*.json in the run folder, which includes the plan session when the run planned. Convergence uses this run's iterations over the plan-wide done count, as run.sh did. Repeat-blocked state is in memory per run (Iterator.blockedAt), not on the task: state/v1 has no blocked_head field, so a resumed run starts the pair afresh. Exit 7 only when the work session exited non-zero or is_error AND left no valid proposal (as run.sh); a failing review session is still treated as a FAIL verdict. Exit 7 writes the closing commit; exit 9 sets plan status halted in state.json but commits nothing. Side effects on earlier tests: the stall halt (default limit 2) and repeat-blocked made two earlier tests exit 3/8, so TestRun17StaleHandoff and the no-gate_dispute subtest of TestRunGateDispute now pass --stall-limit 99 (the latter also touches a marker file each attempt so the repeat-blocked rule does not fire). Pre-existing failure outside this gate: cmd/vloop TestWorkedExampleEnglishSession (config list now has run.* keys).
